description: Sample LPMP batch spec. See DEVELOPERS_GUIDE.md 'Batch Mode' for full details. Only 'model' is required per run — start_date and stop_date are optional. A bare top-level list of runs is also accepted (e.g. [{"model": "a.yaml"}, {"model": "b.yaml"}]).

runs.description: Falls back to CLI --start-date/--stop-date if set, else model settings, else unbounded
Each model may appear at most once per spec; a repeated model is rejected at load time
